name: BidSwapPoints
description: The bid FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far bid forward points - near offer forward point". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

name: OfferSwapPoints
description: The offer FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far offer forward points - near bid forward points". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

name: LegBidForwardPoints
description: The bid FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

name: LegOfferForwardPoints
description: The offer FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

name: SwapPoints
description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

name: MDQuoteType

name: LastSwapPoints
description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the last market event for the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer in a fill or partial fill. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

name: SideGrossTradeAmt

name: LegLastForwardPoints

name: LegCalculatedCcyLastQty

name: LegGrossTradeAmt
description: The gross trade amount of the leg. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when LegLastQty and other quantity fields are express in terms of contract size.

name: MaturityTime

name: RefOrderID
description: The ID reference to the order being hit or taken.

name: RefOrderIDSource
description: Used to specify the source for the identifier in RefOrderID(1080). This can be an identifier provided in order depth market data when hitting (taking) a specific order or to identify what type of order or quote reference is being provided when seeking credit limit check. In the context of US CAT this can be used to identify related orders and quotes which are parent, previous, or manual orders or quotes. Previous relates to orders changing their unique system assigned order identifier.

name: SecondaryDisplayQty
description: Used for reserve orders when DisplayQty applies to the primary execution market (e.g.an ECN) and another quantity is to be shown at other markets (e.g. the exchange). On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

name: DisplayWhen

name: DisplayMethod

name: DisplayLowQty

name: DisplayHighQty

name: DisplayMinIncr
description: Defines the minimum increment to be used when calculating a random refresh of DisplayQty. A user specifies this when he wants a larger increment than the standard provided by the market (e.g. the round lot size).

name: RefreshQty
description: Defines the quantity used to refresh DisplayQty.

name: MatchIncrement
description: Allows orders to specify a minimum quantity that applies to every execution (one execution could be for multiple counter-orders). The order may still fill against smaller orders, but the cumulative quantity of the execution must be in multiples of the MatchIncrement.

name: MaxPriceLevels
description: Allows an order to specify a maximum number of price levels to trade through. Only valid for aggressive orders and during continuous (autoexecution) trading sessions. Property lost when order is put on book. A partially filled order is assigned last trade price as limit price. Non-filled order behaves as ordinary Market or Limit.

name: PreTradeAnonymity
description: Allows trader to explicitly request anonymity or disclosure in pre-trade market data feeds. Anonymity is relevant in markets where counterparties are regularly disclosed in order depth feeds. Disclosure is relevant when counterparties are not normally visible.

name: HighLimitPrice

name: TradingReferencePrice

description: Price conditions in effect at the time of the trade. Multiple price conditions can be in effect at the same time. Price conditions are usually required to be reported in markets that have regulations on price execution at a market or national best bid or offer, and the trade price differs from the best bid or offer.

description: Trade quantity.

name: SideAvgPx
description: Calculated average price for this side of the trade.

name: SideAvgPxIndicator
description: Used to indicate whether a trade or a sub-allocation should be allocated at the trade price (e.g. no average pricing), or whether it should be grouped with other trades/sub-allocations and allocated at the average price of the group.

values.meaning: Trade is part of an average price group identified by the AvgPxGroupID(1731)
Last trade of the average price group identified by the AvgPxGroupID(1731)
Trade is part of a notional value average price group

name: SideAvgPxGroupID
description: The identifier for the average price group for the trade side. See also AvgPxGroupID(1731).

name: NoRelatedTrades

name: RelatedTradeID
description: Identifier of a related trade.

name: RelatedTradeIDSource

name: RelatedTradeDate
description: Date of a related trade.

name: RelatedTradeMarketID
description: Market of execution of related trade.

name: RelatedTradeQuantity
description: Quantity of the related trade which can be less than or equal to the actual quantity of the related trade. For example, when one trade offsets another across asset classes.

name: NoRelatedPositions
description: Number of related positions.

name: RelatedPositionID
description: Identifier of a related position.

name: RelatedPositionIDSource
description: Describes the source of the identifier that RelatedPositionID(1862) represents.

name: RelatedPositionDate
description: Used to help identify the position when RelatedPositionID(1862) is not unique across multiple days. This date is generally the creation date of the identifier.

name: QuoteAckStatus
description: Acknowledgement status of a Quote(35=S) or QuoteCancel(35=Z) message submission.

name: StrikeIndex
description: Specifies the index used to calculate the strike price.

name: OfferID
description: Unique identifier for the ask side of the quote assigned by the quote issuer.

description: Result of party detail definition for one party.

description: Reference to an EntitlementID(1776). Used for modification or deletion of an entitlement.

name: SettlPriceUnitOfMeasure

description: Indicates the currency of the settlement price unit of measure if expressed in another currency than the base currency.

description: Timestamp of the match event. For off-exchange trades the time at which the deal was matched by the exchange.

description: Number of instrument match sides.

description: Number of trade match sides.

name: TrdMatchSubID
description: Used to identify each price level, step or clip within a match event.

name: NoLegExecs

description: The ExecID(17) value corresponding to a trade leg.

name: LegTradeID
description: The TradeID(1003) value corresponding to a trade leg.

name: LegTradeReportID
description: The TradeReportID(571) value corresponding to a trade leg.

name: TradeMatchAckStatus
description: Used to indicate the status of the trade match report submission.

name: TradeMatchRejectReason
description: Reason the trade match report submission was rejected.

name: SideMarketSegmentID
description: Identifies the market segment of the side.

name: SideVenueType
description: Identifies the type of venue where the trade was executed for the side.

name: SideExecRefID
description: Used to reference the value from SideExecID(1427).

name: LegExecRefID
description: Used to reference the value from LegExecID(1893).

name: HaircutIndicator
description: Indicates, if "Y", that a stated valuation includes a haircut, e.g. that the stated value reflects the subtraction of the haircut. Note that a value of "N" does not imply a haircut is not applicable, only that the haircut (if any) is not reflected in the stated valuation.

name: RegulatoryTradeID
description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

name: RegulatoryTradeIDEvent
description: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

name: RegulatoryTradeIDSource
description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

name: RegulatoryTradeIDType
description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in RegulatoryTradeID(1903).

name: NoRegulatoryTradeIDs
description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

name: NoAllocRegulatoryTradeIDs
description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

name: AllocRegulatoryTradeID
description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDSource
description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDEvent
description: Identifies the event which caused the origination of the identifier in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2(Clearing).

name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDType
description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

name: NumOfCompetitors
description: The number of competing Respondents (e.g. dealers) to receive a quote request (either via the QuoteRequest(35=R) or via other means).

name: ResponseTime
description: The time by which a meaningful response should arrive back (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT").

name: QuoteDisplayTime
description: Time by which the quote will be displayed.

name: ExposureDurationUnit
description: Time unit in which the ExposureDuration(1629) is expressed.

name: CoverPrice
description: The best quoted price received among those not traded.

name: NoClearingAccountTypes
description: Number of clearing account type entries.

name: NoPriceMovements
description: Number of price movement entries.

name: NoPriceMovementValues
description: Number of price movement value entries.

name: PriceMovementValue
description: Value at specific price movement point.

name: PriceMovementPoint
description: Price movement point up (positive integer) or down (negative integer) relative to the underlying price of the instrument.

name: PriceMovementType
description: Describes the format of the PriceMovementValue(1921).

name: ClearingIntention
description: Specifies the party's or parties' intention to clear the trade.

name: TradeClearingInstruction
description: Specifies the eligibility of this trade for clearing and central counterparty processing.

values.meaning: Automatic posting mode (trade posting to the position account number specified)
Automatic give-up mode (trade give-up to the give-up destination number specified)

name: BackloadedTradeIndicator
description: Indicates that the trade being reported occurred in the past and is still in effect or active.

name: ConfirmationMethod
description: Specifies how a trade was confirmed.

name: MandatoryClearingIndicator
description: An indication that the trade is flagged for mandatory clearing.

name: MixedSwapIndicator
description: An indication that the trade is a mixed swap.

name: OffMarketPriceIndicator
description: An indication that the price is off-market.

name: VerificationMethod
description: Indication of how a trade was verified.

name: ClearingRequirementException
description: Specifies whether a party to a swap is using an exception to a clearing requirement. In the US, one such clearing requirement is CFTC's rule pursuant to CEA Section 2(h)(1).

name: IRSDirection
description: Used to specify whether the principal is paying or receiving the fixed rate in an interest rate swap.

name: RegulatoryReportType
description: Type of regulatory report.

Volume Omission Trade Eligible for Subsequent Aggregated Enrichment
Full Details of "Four Weeks Aggregation Trade"
Full Details in Aggregated Form of "Volume Omission Trade Eligible for Subsequent Aggregated Enrichment"

name: VoluntaryRegulatoryReport
description: Used in conjunction with RegulatoryReportType(1934) to indicate whether the trade report is a voluntary regulatory report. If not specified, the default for a regulatory report is "N".

name: TradeCollateralization
description: Specifies how the trade is collateralized.

name: TradeContinuation
description: Specifies the post-execution trade continuation or lifecycle event. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

name: AssetClass
description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

name: AssetSubClass
description: The subcategory description of the asset class.

name: AssetType
description:
Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in AssetSubClass(1939).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed.
Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

name: SwapClass
description: The classification or type of swap. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

name: NthToDefault
description: The Nth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. If specified without MthToDefault(1943) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If MthToDefault(1943) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

name: MthToDefault
description: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When NthToDefault(1942) and MthToDefault(1943) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

name: SettledEntityMatrixSource
description: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

name: SettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
description: The publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. If not specified, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

name: CouponType
description: Coupon type of the bond.

name: TotalIssuedAmount
description: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued securities.

name: CouponFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: CouponFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: CouponDayCount
description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security. Absence of this field for a bond or an interest bearing security transaction implies a "flat" trade, i.e. no accrued interest determined at time of the transaction.

name: ConvertibleBondEquityID
description: Identifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted to.

name: ConvertibleBondEquityIDSource
description: Identifies class or source of the ConvertibleBondEquityID(1951) value.

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: ContractPriceRefMonth
description: Reference month if there is no applicable MaturityMonthYear(200) value for the contract or security.

name: LienSeniority
description: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

name: LoanFacility
description: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

name: ReferenceEntityType
description: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.

name: IndexSeries
description: The series identifier of a credit default swap index.

name: IndexAnnexVersion
description: The version of a credit default swap index annex.

name: IndexAnnexDate
description: The date of a credit default swap index series annex.

name: IndexAnnexSource
description: The source of a credit default swap series annex.

name: AgreementVersion
description: The version of the master agreement

name: MasterConfirmationDesc
description:
The type of master confirmation executed between the parties.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-type for values.

name: MasterConfirmationDate
description: Alternative to broker confirmation. The date of the confirmation executed between the parties and intended to govern all relevant transactions between those parties.

name: MasterConfirmationAnnexDesc
description:
The type of master confirmation annex executed between the parties.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-annex-type for values.

name: MasterConfirmationAnnexDate
description: The date that an annex to the master confirmation was executed between the parties.

name: BrokerConfirmationDesc
description: Describes the type of broker confirmation executed between the parites. Can be used as an alterative to MasterConfirmationDesc(1962). See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/broker-confirmation-type for values.

name: CreditSupportAgreementDesc
description: The type of ISDA Credit Support Agreement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-support-agreement-type for values.

name: CreditSupportAgreementDate
description: The date of the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties and intended to govern collateral arrangements for all OTC derivatives transactions between those parties.

name: CreditSupportAgreementID
description: A common reference or unique identifier to identify the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties.

name: GoverningLaw
description: Identification of the law governing the transaction. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/governing-law for values.

name: NoSideRegulatoryTradeIDs
description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

name: SideRegulatoryTradeID
description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organziations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifier (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDSource
description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDEvent
description: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDType
description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

name: NoSecondaryAssetClasses
description: Number of secondary asset classes in the repeating group.

name: SecondaryAssetClass
description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure for a multi-asset trade.

name: SecondaryAssetSubClass
description: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

name: SecondaryAssetType
description:
Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in SecondaryAssetSubClass(1978).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed.
Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

name: BlockTrdAllocIndicator
description: Indication that a block trade will be allocated.

name: NoUnderlyingEvents
description: Number of events in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingEventType
description: Code to represent the type of event.

name: UnderlyingEventDate
description: The date of the event.

name: UnderlyingEventTime
description: The time of the event. To be used in combination with UnderlyingEventDate(1983).

name: UnderlyingEventTimeUnit
description: Time unit associated with the event.

name: UnderlyingEventTimePeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the event.

name: UnderlyingEventPx
description: Predetermined price of issue at event, if applicable.

name: UnderlyingConstituentWeight
description: For a basket, or pool, describes the weight of each of the constituents within the basket. If not provided, it is assumed to be equal weighted.

name: UnderlyingCouponType
description: Specifies the coupon type of the underlying bond.

name: UnderlyingTotalIssuedAmount
description: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued security.

name: UnderlyingCouponFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: UnderlyingCouponFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: UnderlyingCouponDayCount
description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

name: UnderlyingObligationID
description: For a CDS basket or pool identifies the reference obligation.

name: UnderlyingObligationIDSource
description: Identifies the source scheme of the UnderlyingObligationID(1994).

name: UnderlyingEquityID
description: Specifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted.

name: UnderlyingEquityIDSource
description: Identifies the source of the UnderlyingEquityID(1996).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)
